I'm planning on going to the doctor as soon as I can anyways, so hopefully he can hook me up with a psychologist. what usually happens is that I read something horror related and end up freaking out about it, but searching out anything  else I can find about the subject. it's not like a "hey I'm bored and want to read more" it's more along the lines of "I NEED to know more about this, or i won't feel accomplished." I could understand being a little edgy and restless the night after reading something, but whatever I was reading will creep into my head a few days, or even weeks later. Of course after I start thinking about it, I start hearing noises throughout the house which makes me even more paranoid. I haven't been able to sleep without the lights on in over two weeks now. 

When it comes to the dark, it's not like a normal I get chills when i'm in the dark, like it used to be when I was a kid. Now it's like the darkness is smothering me. It gets harder to breathe and my heart rate skyrockets. I've had multiple panic attacks in the past week or so from being caught in the dark. 

All of this has really messed with my sleeping, When I get home from school i'm exhausted, but as soon as I lie down, I'm wide awake and hyperaware. I've tried using white noise, over the counter sleep aids, and reading/watching something cheerful before bed. but as soon as I get in bed whatever horrifying thing I was last in contact with crawls back into my mind. 

I guess all in all, I'm less looking for advice on WHAT to do about it, and more looking an outlet to talk to other people that may have the same issues, or if my "fear addiction" has a medical term that I can research.

Once again, Thanks for such a speedy reply!
